        3 % faster -> a dominated form drops out
    (c) the rest: the 94-token decision (tv4_000:q0) median, within 3 % -> b_m01_first5 shared's median, within 3 % -> the
        fewer call lengths

round11.what: round 11: the Swift host's decision latency (`kev time`, Release, AOT .aimodelc, SpecializationOptions.default) per GDN-scan form x S, the forms A B C ... rules.candidates: the forms that passed round 11's full gate (fixture 434 + held-out 130 + red arms + reset), and U16
rules.rank: the median of tv4_000:q0 (94 tokens, one decision) over every decision of the form, smallest first
rules.excluded: a form 5 % or more slower than U16 on any of the 10 items (median vs median)
rules.tie: within 3 % = a tie, broken by b_m01_first5 shared's median (smaller first), then within 3 % again by the smaller S

pairwise.by: tie on tv4_000:q0 (within 3 %): b_m01_first5 shared median

clean.rule:
r11 timing, the continuation in the same turn (supervisor 10:0x): rounds 3 (and 4) until every form has two clean
processes, then the ranking on clean processes only, the JIT / Python processes if missing or not clean, then the
verify steps. A step of r11_locked.py's plan; appends the next steps to the plan file.
clean (fixed by the supervisor before round 3): no other GPU job during the process (drivers waiting for their turn do
not count) and the 1-minute load average <= 12 at its start and at its end. Round 1 is contended as a whole (load 15-43).
